lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下黑印。
lines.en: A black smudge follows my steps.
It's like walking on coal dust.
I'm slow, and shedding grit.
There should be coal beneath this.
I drag a dark trail behind me.
Every step sheds black flecks.
I make for that stone wall.
The cracks on me are full of black.
I'm looking for a place to burst.
I cross grass and it blackens.
I circle the ore vein.
I'm not chasing. Just walking.
My shadow is one black patch.
Each step darkens the ground.
No detours. Straight on.
The gravel under me turns black.
I stand and slowly swell.
Coal grit falls off me.
The stone here is hard.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的位置。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the right spot.
Something is ticking inside me.
I neither eat nor sleep.
Black dust piles at my feet.
I stay still, like a lump of ore.
I smell of deep underground.
I looked down.
This spot will do nicely.
I haven't started to swell yet.
I count the rock above me.
Scratch me and black shows.
I hold still against the stone.

lines.zh: 身上掉下的渣堆成一小堆。
lines.en: The grit piles up beside me.
You're carrying a lot of iron.
Do I look like a lump of coal?
Where you stand will turn black.
Mining? There's some here.
Don't bring that torch so close.
I'm looking at the stone under you.
That pick of yours is decent.
I don't hurt anyone. Truly.
Step back. I'm about to burst.
Your boots are black already.
I want to turn this ground to coal.
Don't expect me to dodge.
A lump of coal fell off me.
That didn't interrupt me.
The cracks on me got wider.
All you got was dust.
I moved back, leaving marks.
I don't feel much.
Black grit coated your hands.
I'm still swelling inward.
That made me swell more.
Hit me again and it comes early.

lines.zh: 你手里是什么？我看不清。
lines.en: What's in your hand? I can't see.
I don't eat food. I eat stone.
That thing is in my way.
Keep it away. I'm swelling.
Trade that for my life?

lines.zh: 我不缺，我缺一块好地方。
lines.en: I lack nothing but a good spot.
Coal dust covers the smell.
You smell of ore.
Don't wave it. I can't make out the shape.
Your trinket is worth less than a lump of coal.
Are you trying to stop me?
Move it. I want to see the stone.
I won't fall for it. I want ore.
Your thing is too bright.
I can't smell food in that.
Put it down. Don't block me.
Bump me and you're covered in black.
I'm harder than I look.

lines.zh: 身上的渣蹭到你衣服上。
lines.en: Grit rubbed onto your clothes.
Don't crowd me. I'm swelling.
Your retreat left marks on the ground.
I barely move.
The bump shook loose some coal dust.
There's black on your armor now.
A stone broke under my foot.
Don't touch. It sheds.
I don't do this.
Two of me would burst into two coal patches.
Don't watch. There's dust.
When we come close, the ground blackens.
It's a bit bigger than me.
We pressed together and grit fell everywhere.
This patch of coal is what we leave.
Neither of us is less afterwards.
Look, the hole is round.

lines.zh: 我们不需要多余的东西。
lines.en: We need nothing extra.
This black stone has weight.
There's something in this stone.
I press it into my chest.
I picked it up and shed grit.
The black lump on the ground is mine.
I carried it a few steps.
This is quite light.
I picked up some rubble.
What you dropped is half black now.
I pile things at my feet.
There's coal where you're standing.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在石壁边。
lines.en: I see you, by the stone wall.
I'm walking over. Don't dodge.
I'm turning this patch black.
Step back. The blast radius is decent.
I count to three, then start.
That vein behind you is mine.
The cracks on me are glowing.
It won't matter if you don't dodge.
I've found my spot.
I shuffle off toward the seam.

lines.zh: 你走到那堆石头后面了。
lines.en: You went behind that pile of stone.
The black grit you crushed still glints.

lines.zh: 这里的石块颜色有点浅。
lines.en: The stone here is a little pale.
I'm not fast, but I'll get there.
The further you retreat, the smaller the patch.
Grit keeps falling off me.
This ground only takes one burst.
You circle back; I've been waiting.
I edge along the wall.

lines.zh: 我炸开的时候，地上全黑了。
lines.en: When I burst, the ground went black.
Not hurting you. Changing the ground.
Coal dust hit your face.
Black dust bursts out; you stagger back.
All this stone turned to coal.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂开，黑灰飞出来。
lines.en: My skin split and black dust flew.
Dust got into your armor gaps.
The grass on the ground is gone.
There isn't much of me left.
Round hole, isn't it.
I ooze out of a fissure in the rock.
There's a lot of coal down here.
I landed quietly.
A black streak appeared on the wall.
I smell ore.
The stone on this level is soft.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，掉了一地渣。
lines.en: I stood up and grit fell everywhere.
I waited here a while.
You've been digging up there.
My cracks are still glowing.

lines.zh: 火把煤点着了，我全身都在烧。
lines.en: Fire caught the coal and I burned all over.
I scattered into grit on landing.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我身上的煤全湿了。
lines.en: Water soaked all the coal on me.
Both bursts went off and stone flew.
The arrow pulled out a puff of black.

lines.zh: 这光把我身上的煤照白了。
lines.en: That light bleached the coal on me.
I don't eat. I need stone.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我表面全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my surface charred.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石头可以变。
lines.en: There's no stone to change in the void.
